subject: Private offer: renewal + incremental capacity amendment
messages:
From: Lisa Zhang <lisa.zhang@novamed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & incremental capacity request — private offer on GCP marketplace

Hi Irene,

Hope youre well. Our renewal for NovaMeds Redwood deployment is coming up (current term ends 2029-01-31) and wed like to: 

- Extend the private offer to 24 months from the renewal date,
- Add an incremental 30% capacity uplift for Q1-Q4 2029 (anticipated burst for new patient analytics workload), and
- Have the billing route through our GCP Marketplace private offer (we prefer marketplace invoicing).

I've attached a provisional PO (NovaMed_PO_2028-09.pdf) with our internal approvers. Before we loop procurement, can you confirm:

1) Whether Redwood can amend the existing private-offer terms to cover the incremental capacity as a single amendment,
2) If the marketplace path requires any special tax or signing steps on your side (we are EU-sub entity taxed in US), and
3) A ballpark on pricing for the 30% uplift and any term-based concessions for 24 months.

If easier, happy to jump on a short call this week.

Thanks — appreciate the help.

— Lisa Zhang
Head of Cloud Ops, NovaMed Health
Attachments: NovaMed_PO_2028-09.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Zhang <lisa.zhang@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & incremental capacity request — private offer on GCP marketplace

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Quick answers up front, then a proposed next-step plan below.

Short answers:
- Yes: we can accommodate the 30% incremental capacity as an amendment to your existing private offer on GCP (no need to create a brand new PO).
- Marketplace billing: well need your Marketplace account ID and the billing contact; theres a standard acceptance step in Googles flow but we handle the DocuSign + private-offer update on our side.
- Pricing: Ill confirm a firm quote after internal alignment, but expect the uplift to be priced as a prorated add-on for the remainder of the renewal term with a modest term discount for annualizing to 24 months.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Can you share the GCP Marketplace customer ID and the PO line items you want applied to marketplace invoicing?
2) Ill route to our pricing & legal (ccd) and get a redlined amendment + DocuSign ready.
3) Target timeline: draft amendment in 48 hours, internal review + hubspot update by EOD Thu, final DocuSign by next Tuesday (9/19) if approvals align.

Ccd Kimberly (pricing) and Priyom (marketplace ops) to confirm the pricing approach and any acceptance window constraints.

If youd like, we can do a 20-min call Wed afternoon to run through the PO mapping.

Best,
Irene
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & incremental capacity request — private offer on GCP marketplace

On Tue, Sep 12, 2028 at 09:08, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Quick answers up front, then a proposed next-step plan below.

Thanks Irene — noted. My thinking:

- Pricing stance: suggest we quote the 30% uplift pro-rated over the remaining months of the current term, with the larger benefit applied once they commit to 24 months. For simplicity, present two numbers: (A) pro-rated add-on for remainder of term + (B) consolidated 24-month total and implied effective discount. That gives procurement visibility.
- Discount: recommend 7% effective discount on the uplift if they sign 24 months and commit to a minimum monthly baseline (keeps unit economics safe).
- Acceptance windows: Priyom, can we confirm GCP acceptance lead time if we push an amendment through their private-offer record? Need to know if marketplace acceptance will create any invoice timing gaps.

Attachments Ill prep: revised-private-offer-terms-2028-09.docx (draft amendment) and a one-page pricing comparison.

Ben, FYI — if NovaMed expects to shift invoicing to GCP marketplace we may need finance to tag the customer differently for tax handling; I will loop Ben if we need a tax/reseller check.

—Kimberly
Sr. Pricing Manager
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Zhang <lisa.zhang@novamed.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & incremental capacity request — private offer on GCP marketplace

Lisa — following up with the plan and next artifacts attached.

What were delivering now:
- Draft amendment (revised-private-offer-terms-2028-09.docx): captures the 30% capacity uplift, the 24-month term, and the prorated pricing for the current partial period.
- Provisional DocuSign link for signature: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ND-095-docusign
- PO mapping checklist (inline):
  * Confirm GCP Marketplace customer ID (we need this to route invoices)
  * Confirm billing contact and remit-to address for marketplace invoicing
  * Confirm whether NovaMed wants the uplift billed as a single invoice or split across quarterly invoices

Pricing summary (high level):
- Option A: Pro-rated add-on for remainder of current term (list price x 30% prorate) — immediate invoice upon amendment acceptance.
- Option B: Consolidated 24-month commitment (preferred): we roll the uplift into a 24-month private-offer amendment and apply a 7% uplift discount on the additional capacity portion. This smooths invoices and locks price for 24 months.

Requested next steps from NovaMed: 
1) Reply with GCP Marketplace customer ID and billing contact, or attach updated PO line items mapped to the marketplace SKU.
2) If Option B is acceptable, confirm and well send the DocuSign envelope to your procurement contact for signature (link above).

Im available for a 20-min call today at 3pm PT if youd rather talk through the options — otherwise we can proceed by email.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: revised-private-offer-terms-2028-09.docx
